plan.question: Do personal-video auxiliary losses help when simulator adaptation labels are scarce?
plan.train_scene_seeds: 10000 through 10031, selected by index without reading outcomes
plan.initialization: reuse frozen completed primary phone-video encoders; R uses the same original ImageNet encoder
plan.control_and_scoring: identical frozen primary physics and state machine
plan.selection: all 15 final checkpoints and all 64 test scenes; no checkpoint/group/seed selection
plan.interpretation: label-budget comparison at equal optimizer steps, not equal dataset epochs; no new real or synthetic test distribution
